topics.label: Introduction and lecture overview
topics.groupedBecause: It introduces the lecture by connecting to prior practical sessions and outlining the key learning outcomes.

topics.label: Discovery and experimental testing of viral and cellular oncogenes
topics.groupedBecause: They trace how tumor virology revealed cellular proto-oncogenes and establish the laboratory assays used to test gene transforming capacity.

topics.label: Classification and mechanisms of oncogenes and tumor suppressor genes
topics.groupedBecause: They define the functional classes of cancer genes and illustrate how specific mutations alter cell cycle checkpoints and gene dosage effects.

topics.label: Sources and mechanisms of genetic instability in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: They examine how failures in DNA repair pathways, replication proofreading, and mitotic chromosome segregation produce sequence and chromosomal instability.

topics.label: Multistep tumor progression and hereditary cancer predisposition
topics.groupedBecause: They describe how the stepwise accumulation of mutations drives cancer progression and how inherited mutations accelerate tumor development and evolution.

topics.label: Conclusion and reading recommendation
topics.groupedBecause: It concludes the lecture with recommended reading and an outlook on the upcoming session.
